Bisher erhaltene Abrechnungen der Leistungserbringer und/oder deren Dienstleistern, die in Papierform eingehen, sollen durch den Auftragnehmer digitalisiert und so der Auftraggeberin zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Dadurch erleichtert sich für die Auftraggeberin die Rechnungs- bearbeitung und es wird Potenzial für Prozessoptimierungen und -automatisierungen geschaf- fen. Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. 1.1 Losbildung Eine Losbildung unterbleibt, da ein ganzheitlicher Scandienst mit der Gesamtverantwortung des künftigen Auftragnehmers ausgeschrieben wird. Ausgeschrieben wird ein Rahmenvertrag mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Bieter sind aufgefordert, ein Angebot einzureichen. 1.2 Art der Vergabe Die Auftraggeberin schreibt die benötigten Leistungen in einem offenen Verfahren im Sinne von § 15 VgV aus. Dieses Vergabeverfahren wird aus Gründen der Transparenz über eine elektronische Vergabeplattform betrieben. Die Auftraggeberin verwendet ausschließ lich die Vergabeplattform der DTVP Deutsches Vergabeportal GmbH (www.dtvp.de). Es ist das zum Zeitpunkt der Veröffentlichung der Bekanntmachung geltende Vergaberecht maßgeblich, auch, wenn dieses sich während des Vergabeverfahrens ändern sollte. This is a nonpersonal services contract requesting software development of Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) interfaces for the Mission Termination System (MTS), yielding a Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product . MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. The contractor shall provide all management, personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportatio

ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2.
